program_config.description: Functional independence through written, visual, combined, multistep, checklist, schedule, and routine-based directions using accessible supports.

instructions.circuit: Circuit presents all 10 targets in the selected benchmark once in a newly randomized order and prevents the immediately previous full order from repeating.
instructions.purpose: Teach functional independence by following written, visual, combined, multistep, checklist, schedule, and routine-based directions across relevant environments.
teaching_procedure: Gain attention and present the actual written, visual, checklist, schedule, or combined cue required by the target.
Allow approximately 3–5 seconds for an independent response when appropriate.
Use the least intrusive prompt needed and fade prompts systematically.
Honor AAC, pointing, adapted writing/input methods, motor supports, and other individualized accessibility supports.
Score Correct, Prompted, or Incorrect / No Response and reinforce according to the learner plan.
instructions.mastered_distractors: Use Mastered Target inserts learner-specific mastered Functions targets into D trials as maintenance opportunities.
